notes: Nine navigate() sites confirmed (brief said six). Functional search reducer verified supported in @tanstack/router-core 1.171.20.

gate_1_decisions.encoding: repeated params (?status=todo&status=done); bare-string arrival is the load-bearing primary path
gate_1_decisions.overwrite_behavior: URL overwrites viewer's stored filters for the project - CONFIRMED INTENTIONAL, record in final report as accepted UX consequence
gate_1_decisions.empty_param_predicate: ?status= must not count as 'URL has filters'; own dedicated test

open_issues_for_gate_2: Premise in run params falsified: zod IS a dep of apps/web (^4.4.3) and IS used as validateSearch on 5 routes. Hand-written narrowing still chosen, for sibling-route consistency + no-throw (AC-5), not for absence of a library.

Architect's H1 proof rests on 'every route uses a plain fn validator' - false. Conclusion still holds (those zod schemas are all optional strings, input==output) but the proof is weaker than stated. Typecheck is the real gate.
FR-6 reinterpreted: emit key-present-with-undefined, not key-omitted. Needed or filters can never be cleared.
AC-7 guard is two-tier; tier 2 is a source-text assertion, forced by allowlist granularity (no legal test path under kanban-board/ or list-view/index).
New behaviour beyond literal ACs: localStorage-restored filters get written into the URL on mount (one extra replace nav). Gate 2 may veto.

verification_after_source.biome_changed_paths: pass (1 pre-existing warning in untouched code)

deviations: P3 split into 3 region packets (tp_p3a/b/c) instead of 1 whole-file packet - lower drift risk, same diff. Packet count 11 -> 13.

H1 FALSIFIED BY TYPECHECK: bare `search: (prev) =>` fails TS7006 at all 10 sites. Fixed with `(prev: Record<string, unknown>)`, matching the repo's own validateSearch signature style. Verified: TS7006 10 -> 0.
Site count is 10, not 9: board.tsx now has 2 (sheet-close + new filter-publish). Guard test count assertion must be 10 with per-file 2/2/2/2/2.
Diff-preview mini-gate per edited file batched to Gate 3 rather than 7 separate stops, per coordinator instruction to run through to Gate 3.

verification_final.ac7_mutation_check: re-run post-F1: 16/17 fail pre-fix, all pass post-fix

incidents: Scratch-backup basename collision briefly put list-view/index.tsx content into kanban-board/index.tsx during the tier-2 mutation check. Detected by identity grep, repaired from git HEAD, edits re-applied, fully re-verified. No residue.

open_findings_for_gate_3.F1_major: URL is write-only after mount; goes stale via project-layout 'Tasks' button and browser Back. Needs a DIRECTION decision (URL-authoritative vs republish) - not fixable unilaterally.
open_findings_for_gate_3.F2_minor: board.tsx has zero behavioural coverage; validateSearch never invoked by a test. Coupled to F1's chosen direction.
open_findings_for_gate_3.F3_minor: ENCODING DOES NOT MATCH GATE-1 DECISION: router JSON-encodes arrays (?status=%5B%22todo%22%5D), not repeated params. Reading accepts both. Fixing writes needs main.tsx, which is NOT in the allowlist and would change encoding app-wide.
open_findings_for_gate_3.SEC_low_1: No vocabulary validation on closed-set filter values; crafted URL renders <=128 chars of attacker text into a chip (UI spoofing, not XSS).
open_findings_for_gate_3.SEC_low_2: Unguarded localStorage.setItem; URL can dictate value size (~32KB vs ~70B) and key.
